description: This file is a configuration include file (lto.inc) used within the build system (likely Yocto/OpenEmbedded) to manage Link Time Optimization (LTO) settings and flags on a per-package basis. It contains directives to enable or disable LTO for specific packages, set custom flags, and override default options.
